title: 8 June 1968: George Harrison and Ringo Starr visit Joan Baez in California
content:
The day after they arrived in California, George Harrison and Ringo Starr visited folk singer Joan Baez at her home in Carmel, California.

The two Beatles and their wives had flown to America so Harrison could appear in the Ravi Shankar film Raga. They returned to England on 18 June 1968.
